description: Overlay lookup correctness + integration test. Fix the coordinator lifecycle bug (fix B) so in-flight AI results are never dropped and LOOKUP_COMPLETE always fires. Fix speak() to set utterance language by script (fix E). Wire autoSpeak + historyLimit + app-settings persistence in the overlay (fix C-overlay). Create src/storage/app-settings.ts and add pruneHistory to history.ts. Add an RTL/jsdom integration test proving offline->AI replacement. Depends on FEAT-001 (strict baseline must be green first).
steps: INSTALL — Add exact-pinned devDependencies to package.json: @testing-library/react@16.3.3, @testing-library/dom@10.4.2, @testing-library/jest-dom@6.10.0, jsdom@30.1.3. Run `npm install`.

NEW FILE — src/storage/app-settings.ts: Export `interface AppSettings { autoSpeak: boolean; historyLimit: number; theme: 'glass' }`. Export `const DEFAULT_APP_SETTINGS: AppSettings = { autoSpeak: false, historyLimit: 200, theme: 'glass' }`. Export `const APP_SETTINGS_KEY = 'vocabflow.settings'` (only used internally). Export `function loadAppSettings(): Promise<AppSettings>` — follows the exact pattern of loadSettings() in src/storage/settings.ts: `return new Promise((resolve) => { chrome.storage.local.get('vocabflow.settings', (r) => { const stored = r?.['vocabflow.settings'] as Partial<AppSettings> | undefined; resolve({ ...DEFAULT_APP_SETTINGS, ...stored }) }) })`. Export `async function saveAppSettings(s: AppSettings): Promise<void>` — `await chrome.storage.local.set({ 'vocabflow.settings': s })`.

MODIFY — src/storage/history.ts: Add `export async function pruneHistory(limit: number): Promise<void>` at the end of the file. Implementation: `if (!Number.isFinite(limit) || limit <= 0) return; const all = await listHistory(); const toDelete = all.slice(limit); for (const entry of toDelete) { if (entry.id !== undefined) await deleteHistory(entry.id) }`. (listHistory() is already defined and returns entries sorted descending by timestamp, so all.slice(limit) gives the oldest entries beyond the limit.)

FIX B — src/ui/Overlay.tsx: (1) Replace `const [historyId, setHistoryId] = useState<number | null>(null)` with `const historyIdRef = useRef<number | null>(null)`. (2) In persistHistory: change `historyId !== null && lastWord.current === r.word` to `historyIdRef.current !== null && lastWord.current === r.word`; change `await updateHistory(historyId, ...)` to `await updateHistory(historyIdRef.current as number, ...)`; change `setHistoryId(id)` to `historyIdRef.current = id`. (3) Change persistHistory's dependency array from `[historyId]` to `[]`. (4) In toggleSave: change `if (historyId === null) return` to `if (historyIdRef.current === null) return`; change `await updateHistory(historyId, ...)` to `await updateHistory(historyIdRef.current, ...)`. The coordinator useEffect already depends on `[persistHistory]` — since persistHistory is now stable ([] deps), the coordinator is created once and cancel() is called only on unmount. Do NOT remove useState import — it is still used by pos, query, result, loading, error, view, menuOpen, saved.

FIX E — src/ui/Overlay.tsx: Read src/providers/offline/index.ts FIRST to confirm isBengali is re-exported from it. Add import: `import { isBengali } from '../providers/offline'`. Rename the speak() function to speakWord(word: string) and replace its body: `try { const u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(word); u.lang = isBengali(word) ? 'bn-IN' : 'en-US'; speechSynthesis.cancel(); speechSynthesis.speak(u) } catch { /* Speech is optional. */ }`. Update the Pronounce button onClick to: `() => speakWord(result.word)`.

FIX C-overlay — src/ui/Overlay.tsx: (1) Add imports: `import { loadAppSettings } from '../storage/app-settings'` and `import { pruneHistory } from '../storage/history'` (add pruneHistory to the existing history import line). (2) Add refs after the existing refs block: `const autoSpeakRef = useRef(false)` and `const historyLimitRef = useRef(200)` and `const resultRef = useRef<LookupResult | null>(null)`. (3) Add a mount-only useEffect: `useEffect(() => { void loadAppSettings().then((s) => { autoSpeakRef.current = s.autoSpeak; historyLimitRef.current = s.historyLimit }) }, [])`. (4) In the coordinator onEvent handler inside the LOCAL_RESULT/AI_RESULT branch, also set `resultRef.current = e.result` BEFORE calling persistHistory. (5) In the LOOKUP_COMPLETE branch, after `setLoading(false)`, add: `if (autoSpeakRef.current && resultRef.current) speakWord(resultRef.current.word)`. (6) In persistHistory, after `const id = await addHistory(...)` and before `lastWord.current = r.word`, add: `if (historyLimitRef.current > 0) await pruneHistory(historyLimitRef.current)`.

NEW TEST — tests/overlay.test.tsx: FIRST line must be `// @vitest-environment jsdom` (the docblock vitest picks up). Full content: (1) `// @vitest-environment jsdom` (2) `import '@testing-library/jest-dom/vitest'` (3) imports from @testing-library/react and vitest. (4) `vi.mock('../src/storage/history', () => ({ addHistory: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(1), listSaved: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue([]), updateHistory: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined), pruneHistory: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined) }))`. (5) `vi.mock('../src/storage/app-settings', () => ({ loadAppSettings: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ autoSpeak: false, historyLimit: 200, theme: 'glass' }), DEFAULT_APP_SETTINGS: { autoSpeak: false, historyLimit: 200, theme: 'glass' } }))`. (6) Build the offline entry: `{ headword: 'hello', bn: 'হ্যালো', bnAlts: [], def: 'a greeting', pos: 'noun', syn: [], ant: [], ex: '' }`. (7) Build the AI result as a LookupResult: `{ word: 'hello', source: 'groq' as const, requestId: 'r1', timestamp: Date.now(), englishDefinition: 'a greeting (AI)', bengaliMeaning: 'হ্যালো', exampleEn: 'Hello!', exampleBn: 'হ্যালো!', partOfSpeech: 'noun', synonyms: ['hi'], antonyms: [] }`. (8) In beforeEach, set globalThis.chrome = { runtime: { sendMessage: vi.fn().mockImplementation(async (req: {type?: string}) => { if (req.type === 'VOCABFLOW_SEED') return { ok: true }; if (req.type === 'VOCABFLOW_OFFLINE_LOOKUP') return { ok: true, result: offlineEntry }; if (req.type === 'VOCABFLOW_AI_LOOKUP') return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(() => resolve({ ok: true, result: aiResult }), 40)); return { ok: false, error: 'unknown' } }) }, storage: { local: { get: vi.fn().mockImplementation((key: string, cb: (r: Record<string,unknown>) => void) => { if (key === 'vocabflow.providers') cb({ 'vocabflow.providers': { groq: { apiKey: 'k', enabled: true, model: 'm' }, openrouter: { apiKey: '', enabled: false, model: 'openai/gpt-4o-mini' }, gemini: { apiKey: '', enabled: false, model: 'gemini-2.0-flash' } } }); else cb({}) }), set: vi.fn() } } }. (9) The test: render <Overlay onClose={vi.fn()} />, get the input by placeholder 'Search any word', fireEvent.change to 'hello', fireEvent.keyDown with key 'Enter'. Then: await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText(/Offline dictionary/)).toBeInTheDocument()); await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText(/groq/)).toBeInTheDocument(), { timeout: 2000 }); expect(screen.queryByText('Searching…')).toBeNull().
acceptance_criteria: tests/overlay.test.tsx passes: displays offline result first, then AI result replaces it, and Searching... is cleared after LOOKUP_COMPLETE
The LookupCoordinator is created exactly once per Overlay mount (persistHistory has [] dep array so coordinator useEffect runs once)
speakWord(word) sets u.lang = 'bn-IN' for Bengali words, 'en-US' otherwise
autoSpeak auto-pronounces result word on LOOKUP_COMPLETE when autoSpeakRef.current is true
historyLimit prunes history after each addHistory call via pruneHistory(historyLimitRef.current)
src/storage/app-settings.ts exists and follows the loadSettings pattern
npx tsc -b exits 0; npm run lint exits 0; npm test passes (only 3 live-API tests skip)
findings: All steps implemented and verified. npm test: 42 passed, 3 skipped (live-API). tsc -b: exit 0. lint: exit 0. Test overlay.test.tsx passes: offline result appears first (source: Offline dictionary), then AI result (groq) replaces it, and Searching… is cleared on LOOKUP_COMPLETE. historyIdRef ref-swap (fix B) eliminates stale closures so coordinator is created once. speakWord sets u.lang='bn-IN' for Bengali, 'en-US' otherwise (fix E). autoSpeakRef/historyLimitRef/resultRef wired via loadAppSettings on mount (fix C-overlay). pruneHistory called after addHistory. @testing-library/jest-dom@6.10.0 deprecation warning is cosmetic (pinned version per spec); no functional impact.
